newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Meyer says SNB still mulling gold management.
newsitem.headline: Meyer says SNB still mulling gold management.

text.p: Swiss National Bank (SNB) president Hans Meyer said the SNB was still considering how it might change the management of its gold reserves.

Speaking to reporters after a speech here, Meyer noted, however, that constitutional changes would first have to be made by Switzerland's federal government before any changes could be considered. The SNB last month said it wanted to cut its legally-mandated gold reserve requirement and be given more freedom to manage its currency reserves so it could improve its financial performance.

A working group of officials from the SNB and the Finance Ministry has also proposed that the SNB be permitted to lend gold and to invest in the longer-dated and higher yielding debt of foreign states, banks or international organisations.
The SNB also wants permission to use derivative financial instruments, such as options and futures, to help minimise the market risks to currency reserves, the Swiss central bank said.
